```python
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px


def draw_route_fuel_cost_chart(df: pd.DataFrame) -> "plotly.graph_objs.Figure":
    """
    Draws a line chart of monthly fuel cost in USD for each route.

    Parameters
    ----------
    df : pd.DataFrame
        Must contain columns: 'month', 'route', 'fuel_cost_usd'.

    Returns
    -------
    plotly.graph_objs.Figure
        The generated Plotly figure object.
    """
    fig = px.line(
        df,
        x="month",
        y="fuel_cost_usd",
        color="route",
        labels={
            "month": "Month",
            "fuel_cost_usd": "Fuel Cost [USD]",
            "route": "Route"
        },
        title="Monthly Fuel Cost by Route"
    )
    
    # Ensure the axis label includes units in square brackets as per standing requirement
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Fuel Cost [USD]")
    
    return fig
```
